justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/asm/AsmVisitorWrapper.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/asm/AsmVisitorWrapperNoOpTest.java`. `NoOp` is a singleton enum with no fields and only three trivial pass-through methods (`mergeWriter`, `mergeReader`, `wrap`) that return the input unchanged; the tests confirm this no-op behavior.
